Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
The Y axis does not have to start at 0 — but say so if it doesn’t.
Max 5 lines; more → small multiples or highlight one and mute the rest.
Use dashed lines only for forecast or plan.
Gaps in data are gaps in the line — never interpolate silently.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.

Interaction
Hover / tap: Chart/Crosshair + Chart/Tooltip; legend toggles; brush zooms.

Summary: start, end, min, max and change; table view; points focusable.
